title: CSP and browser isolation
description: Separate Content Security Policy headers from iframe sandbox boundaries and validate postMessage events from an opaque-origin teaching frame.
objectives: Explain what script-src, object-src and base-uri restrict
Recognize why CSP is defense-in-depth rather than input sanitization
Use iframe sandbox without allow-same-origin for untrusted examples
Verify postMessage source, origin and payload before trusting an event
rubric: I explained the difference between CSP headers and iframe sandbox attributes.
I confirmed the frame uses allow-scripts without allow-same-origin.
I verified message source, opaque origin and expected payload checks.
